response.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) * 1.0 / SUM(derived_total_cost) AS rel_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS overall_avg FROM inv) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.avg_qty, i.rel_gap, i.avg_qty - o.overall_avg AS qty_diff FROM inv i CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE i.avg_qty > o.overall_avg ORDER BY qty_diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
